mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders(product_id, buyer_id, seller_id, price, status, payment_method, delivery_method, meetup_location, meetup_time, created_at) VALUES(#{productId}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{price}, #{status}, #{paymentMethod}, #{deliveryMethod}, #{meetupLocation}, #{meetupTime}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT o.*, p.title AS productTitle, p.image_path AS productImage, u_buyer.username AS buyerName, u_seller.username AS sellerName FROM orders o LEFT JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN users u_buyer ON o.buyer_id = u_buyer.id LEFT JOIN users u_seller ON o.seller_id = u_seller.id WHERE o.id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending' AND created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE)
